info.title: Campus Market V1
info.description: Seed accounts only. Tokens expire after 3600 seconds. Account requests: at most 4096 bytes; product writes: at most 65536 bytes. Unknown fields and trailing JSON are rejected. Platform-maintained flat categories validate new writes using current rules; historical reads never revalidate. Product publication atomically creates the archive and independent sale eligibility. Eligibility expires exactly 60×24 hours after server publication time; TTL deletes only eligibility. Images are stored as URLs without reachability checks. Profile updates affect only the authenticated account; credit score stays preset.

get.summary: Browse valid sale listings in one flat category
get.description: Public endpoint. Excludes sold archives, removed sale eligibility, and expiry at or before request validation time, independently of delayed TTL deletion. Sort: publishedAt descending, then product ID descending. Static data pagination has no duplicates or omissions. Concurrent inserts, edits, sales and expiry do not provide a pagination snapshot. Copy nextCursor into cursor for the same category; limit may change between pages.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Exact platform category ID from GET /categories; no child categories. Missing or empty is 400; unknown is 404.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Omitted defaults to 20. Empty, noninteger, out-of-range or repeated values return 400.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from prior page; omit for first page. Unpadded base64url JSON containing categoryId, publishedAt (nonzero RFC3339 timestamp at millisecond precision), id (24 lowercase hex characters). Maximum 512 characters. Empty, malformed, unknown fields, trailing JSON, wrong-category or repeated cursor is 400. Cursor is a position, not a snapshot or authorization token.

400.description: invalid_input: missing/empty/overlong/repeated categoryId, invalid limit or cursor

Recent 5 actual price changes sorted by changedAt and ID descending; initial listing price is separate and new products have empty history.

get.summary: Search currently eligible products with Chinese synonyms
get.description: Search title and description using lucene.smartcn and bicycles_v1 (自行车／单车／脚踏车). Any analyzed query term may match. Returns relevance-ranked first 20 and total using identical current archive/listing eligibility checks. Index ingestion is asynchronous; no request-level snapshot or typo correction is promised. Every candidate batch is checked at its own current time. Repeated q is invalid; timeout or Search failure returns 503.

patch.description: Authenticate using POST /auth/login, authorize in Swagger, publish using POST /products, then change price here. Only the owner of an unsold, unexpired product with an active listing can change price. Initial price and expiresAt remain unchanged. Actual changes atomically persist old/new integer cents and server changedAt; identical price creates no history. Read GET /products/{id} for the latest 5 changes and GET /products/{id}/price-history for all changes. Unknown fields are rejected; at most 4096 request bytes.

200.description: Current product after atomic price/history commit; same-price request succeeds without adding history.

400.description: invalid_input: invalid ID, missing/invalid integer price, unknown fields or more than 4096 request bytes.

401.description: unauthorized: missing, invalid or expired bearer token.

403.description: forbidden: caller does not own product.

409.description: product_unavailable: expired, delisted or sold; same-price requests also require eligibility.

503.description: unavailable: database/transaction failure; price and history changes roll back together.

post.summary: Seller confirms an offline sale atomically
post.description: Only the owner may confirm. Product archive, sale eligibility removal, successful transaction and seller completedSales are committed in one majority-acknowledged MongoDB transaction, using a conditional product update to arbitrate competitors. Same seller/key and same product/buyer/price replay the original result (including concurrent retries); differing content yields idempotency_conflict. Different sellers may use the same key. Validated business failures are permanently recorded and replayed without adding a transaction or incrementing completedSales. Auth, input, missing product, ownership and infrastructure failures only enter logs. Eligibility requires both archive and listing expiry strictly greater than the server confirmation time; equality and later fail even while TTL has not removed the listing. No cancellation, relisting or backdated confirmation. Body limit 4096 bytes; unknown fields and trailing JSON rejected. No transaction is recorded for idempotency_conflict.

200.description: Committed sale or original successful replay. success=true, code=sold.

400.description: invalid_input (including self-sale, missing/invalid key, non-integer or non-positive price) or invalid_buyer. No transaction created.

403.description: forbidden: caller is not product owner. No transaction created.

409.description: Business failure SaleAttempt (success=false, code product_sold/product_expired/product_delisted), or Error with idempotency_conflict for a reused seller/key with different product, buyer or price. Business failures replay identically; key conflicts create no record.

503.description: unavailable: infrastructure failure. No partial state is committed. Retry with the original key/body; an ambiguous commit is resolved by its persisted result.

bearerAuth.description: Paste accessToken from POST /auth/login into Authorize. Valid for one hour.

AttributeValue.description: Non-null scalar or array of non-null scalars. No nested objects or arrays. Extra arrays may mix scalar types. String/array limits are category-dependent: GET /categories supplies current write limits (defaults: 256 Unicode characters, 16 array elements). Historical reads return stored values regardless of current limits.

categoryId.description: ID from GET /categories. Platform defaults: textbooks, bicycles, electronics.

description.description: At most 4000 Unicode characters. Omitted or null becomes an empty string.

items.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL with a hostname and no credentials, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. No reachability check.

attributes.description: Required object. Current rules and limits are returned by GET /categories. Defaults: at most 32 attributes, at most 16 extras, keys match [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]* and have at most 40 ASCII characters; strings at most 256 Unicode characters, arrays at most 16 elements. Category types: string, number, boolean and homogeneous string[]/number[]/boolean[]. Required rules require the key to be present. Extra attributes allow any scalar or mixed scalar array. Reserved keys (case-insensitive): id, categoryId, title, description, condition, images, attributes, sellerId, priceCents, initialPriceCents, publishedAt, expiresAt, sold, sale, seller, available, priceHistory, priceHistoryUrl, buyerId, salePriceCents, confirmedAt. Nested objects and arrays, nulls and standard-field overrides are rejected. These are defaults, not immutable schema ceilings: use the returned current category limits for writes. Historical values are returned without revalidation.
